Force refresh view in LWC

🔴 The Problem: In Aura, we can do to cause standard components to update. How can we do an equivalent in LWC because sfdx refuses to publish .js code with $A in it saying the usage is disallowed in LWC? For now i tricked it with but that is obviously less than ideal....

✅ The Fix: I was able to find an answer on the Developer Docs forum for a work-around. I was surprised how challenging it was to find a solution in the Salesforce LWC docs, so I'm not sure if this is the recommended approach, but it's the best I've been able to find! You will need to import the updateRecord method from the lightning/uiRecordApi . Then, you can call this updateRecord() function in your lwc javascript file...
